parameters.name: DBClusterId
parameters.description: The ID of the PolarDB cluster.

parameters.name: EngineType
parameters.description:
The type of the supported engine. The return value is the sum of the values of the supported engine types.

- 1: Search engine

- 2: LindormTSDB

- 4: LindormTable

- 8: File engine

> For example, if \`EngineType\` is 15 (8 + 4 + 2 + 1), the instance supports the search engine, LindormTSDB, LindormTable, and file engine. If \`EngineType\` is 6 (4 + 2), the instance supports LindormTSDB and LindormTable.

parameters.name: ExpireTime
parameters.description: The expiration time of the cluster. Note: This parameter is returned only for subscription clusters. An empty value is returned for pay-as-you-go clusters.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description:
- If you do not specify the **MaxResults** parameter, the query is not paged. The value of the **MaxResults** parameter in the response indicates the total number of entries.

- If you specify the **MaxResults** parameter, the query is paged. **MaxResults** specifies the number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: **1** to **100**. The value of the **MaxResults** parameter in the response indicates the number of entries on the current page. The recommended value is **20**.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: A token to retrieve the next page of results. Set this parameter to the \`NextToken\` value from a previous call. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first call.

parameters.name: ObjectType
parameters.description: The object type. Valid values: \`TABLE\`, \`PARTITION\_TABLE\`, and \`LOB\`.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID.

> - For more information, see [DescribeRegions](~~98041~~).

- If you do not specify this parameter, the operation queries scheduled tasks in all regions within your account.

parameters.name: TableName
parameters.description: The name of the data table.
